**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Recover the brain session, measure #682 and the milestones, read all 71 open issues + epic + master plan, trace a leak-free staged plan for M5/M8, cross-check it against another agent's plan, and land it in the repo as the single source of truth with the three expired docs marked superseded.

## Instructions
- Reply in Rioplatense Spanish; repo artifacts in English except docs/inbox (Spanish).
- Human signs tickets; agent never merges. PR opening was explicitly authorised this session.

## Discoveries
- #682 = 15/21 tasks, 2/3 slices, 5/6 REQs (REQ-682-5 orphan), 27 commits on the tracker, NO PR to main.
- M5 and M8 at 0%. ADR-0024:53-55 predicts supersede of ADR-0019; #323 argues amend — human gate.
- Stage-set consumer count depends on the axis: 3 files reference the token, 10 non-test modules import sdd-layout.mjs helpers; say which.
- `test/adr-citation-resolves.e2e.test.mjs` scans all docs/; drafts must be cited by filename.
- The engram→.memory hook leaves ALL unsynced records untracked in the active worktree (28 here, 22 from #682 sessions).
- #745 carries both status labels; #732 #699 #697 #327 #268 carry none.

## Accomplished
- Artifact "Del reviewer al router" v3: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/63bcffb1-67ce-47fc-80f4-4e8657076822
- Issue #755 filed, signed by maintainer. PR #756 open, 3 commits, **9/9 checks green**, `type:docs`, 389 lines.
- Cold review (REVISE: 2 blockers, 1 correction, 1 editorial) — all four applied in d2fdfe3.
- Engram: records 2840, 2845 (roadmap/m5-m8-plan), 2850.

## Next Steps
- Maintainer: review/merge PR #756. After merge: comment on epic #313 pointing at docs/inbox/ROADMAP-M5-M8.md.
- Leftover: 28 untracked .memory records in /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-755 (4 about #755). `npm run memory:share` would sweep all; decide where they ship (likely the #682 terminal PR).
- Then Stage 0 of the roadmap: fix #750 on feature/issue-682, slice 3 + REQ-682-5, terminal PR to main.
- Stage 1: the five gates (see roadmap §3) — maintainer rulings on #323, #312, #743, #357.
- Clean worktrees: brain-issue-755 after merge; ~20 stale .claude/worktrees/agent-*.

## Relevant Files
- docs/inbox/ROADMAP-M5-M8.md (branch docs/issue-755-roadmap-single-source-of-truth) — the plan
- docs/inbox/{AGENT-PRIORITY-HANDOFF,MASTER-PLAN-1.0,brain-v2-epic-plan}.md — SUPERSEDED banners only
- brain/scripts/lib/sdd-layout.mjs:68 — REQUIRED_ARTIFACTS, 10 importers
- test/adr-citation-resolves.e2e.test.mjs — the docs citation guard
